title: Research tells one story
items: Research is now four numbered parts: This week, What the model is finding, The bigger picture, and Track record.
The featured read leads with a Matchday read line (team, model, market, gap) and states the difference in points instead of saying 'cooler'.
Upset radar is now Model–market watch, framed as research to watch and grade. Longshots that won shows the lowest pregame chances that still won as cards.
Biggest rating move gets its own panel. Toughest schedules and Conference landscape are compact lists side by side, and the Parity and Teams tabs are folded into three callouts.
Track record pairs Matchday's graded results with Matchday in public (@timurknowsball's picks). The news grid is replaced by a short headline list, with All headlines one click away.
